title: Tuna Mayo Scallion Maki
description: Drained canned tuna, Japanese mayonnaise and scallions with crisp cucumber.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Drain canned tuna very thoroughly and break apart with a fork.
Fold tuna with Kewpie, scallions and soy sauce. The mixture should be creamy but not runny.
Spread rice over nori, align cucumber and a compact strip of tuna filling near the lower third, then roll firmly.
Divide each roll into eight pieces and wipe the knife frequently.
notes: Avoid adding extra liquid from the tuna can to the filling.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
